bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "e80730fe023768ff79310f0cda3c0bb7af15236d"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,time
rid="run_mwymf5g4_c4b6e6cd24"
deadline=time.monotonic()+45
while True:
 o=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/status/"+rid,timeout=5))
 run=o.get("run",o); d=o.get("durable") or run.get("durable") or {}
 cursor=d.get("workflow_cursor") or {}
 if d.get("job_status")!="RUNNING" or cursor.get("step_id")!="DETERMINISTIC_VERIFY" or time.monotonic()>=deadline:break
 time.sleep(5)
print("RUN "+json.dumps({"run_id":rid,"state":run.get("state"),**{k:d.get(k) for k in ("job_status","generation","active_in_process","workflow_cursor","role_invocations","last_execution_error","last_execution_failure")}},ensure_ascii=False)[:20000])
PY
docker exec debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1 node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),p=require("node:path"),root="/sandbox-jobs/jobs";for(const j of fs.readdirSync(root).filter(x=>/^JOB_/.test(x)).map(x=>({x,m:fs.statSync(p.join(root,x)).mtimeMs})).sort((a,b)=>b.m-a.m).slice(0,4)){const dir=p.join(root,j.x);const names=fs.readdirSync(dir);console.log(JSON.stringify({job:j.x,mtime:j.m,files:names.filter(n=>/^[a-z_-]+[.]json$/.test(n))}));for(const name of ["request.json","result.json"]){try{const o=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p.join(dir,name),"utf8"));console.log(name+" "+JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(["action","pass","code","timed_out","duration_ms","timeout_ms","state","snapshot_qualification"].filter(k=>k in o).map(k=>[k,o[k]]))))}catch{}}}'
